title: Ternary semi-direct products in semi-abelian categories
summary: We study the construction of ternary semi-direct products in semi-abelian categories, following a definition of higher semi-direct product previously introduced by Carrasco and Cegarra for groups and Lie algebras. We show that these objects are determined by actions and equivariant morphisms satisfying a certain compatibility condition in the ambient category, and that actions by semi-direct products are a special case of this construction.
